company.name: Playgama
company.shortDescription: Playgama is a fast-growing PaaS ecosystem for game developers and a distributor of HTML5 games
company.description: Playgama is a fast-growing distributor of HTML5 games, connecting developers to an audience of 220 million monthly active players. We simplify game distribution and monetization, allowing developers to focus on creating exceptional games while we handle the rest. With open-source SDK, games distributed thought Playgama can reach players across leading high-traffic platforms, ensuring global exposure—from Europe to Asia and USA.

productsAndServices.description: A browser-based distribution platform offering more than 10,000 HTML5 and WebGL games for desktop, mobile, tablet, and Chromebook users.
productsAndServices.name: Playgama Gaming Platform

productsAndServices.description: An open-source SDK that lets developers integrate game services once and distribute HTML5 games across multiple portals, social networks, messengers, and digital platforms.
productsAndServices.name: Playgama Bridge SDK

productsAndServices.description: A platform-as-a-service offering that publishes HTML5 games across partner platforms and provides advertising, in-game purchase, analytics, quality assurance, and revenue-sharing infrastructure.
productsAndServices.name: Playgama Game Distribution and Monetization Service

productsAndServices.description: An advertising service for web games and gaming portals that provides game-specific ad formats, premium demand, and tools for increasing advertising revenue.
productsAndServices.name: Playgama Ad

productsAndServices.description: A partner program that allows gaming portals and apps to integrate pre-screened Playgama games without hosting or developing the games themselves.
productsAndServices.name: Playgama for Partners

productsAndServices.description: An API that enables partners to retrieve Playgama game listings and integrate the catalog into their own gaming portals or applications.
productsAndServices.name: Playgama Games Catalog API
